title: Propagation optimization encoding
statement: Let $q$ be a positive number of labels, and let a family of encoded Unique Games instances be given. A propagation optimization encoding consists of an encoded maximization problem and, for each semantic instance and each vertex labeling of that instance, a bit-list encoding of the labeling. Every well-formed input of the maximization problem must encode some semantic instance, every canonical instance encoding must be a well-formed input, and every encoded labeling must be feasible. On each canonical instance encoding, the encoded objective value of every labeling must equal its generic CSP value, and the encoded optimum must equal the generic CSP optimum.
hypotheses_covered: The label set $	ext{Fin}(q)$ is nonempty
